title: load
body:
## load

Create declared tables with their keys and constraints, import captured typed JSON or CSV rows in one committed batch, and prove the definitions and every row from a fresh connection. Choose this to put reference data into a schema or to stage tables for later reports.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- CREATE TABLE commits implicitly in Oracle, so a failed load can leave created tables behind; the row import itself is atomic.
- Empty text is NULL in Oracle and is refused unless a column says emptyText is null.

Native binding: `CREATE TABLE; COMMENT; INSERT executemany; COMMIT; fresh-connection SELECT`. Output kind: `["table","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | Name the host-held connection profile and set time limits.
